Class MoveResult

java.lang.Object
chess.service.MoveResult
public final class MoveResult extends Object
The outcome of an attempted move, returned by Game.tryMove(Position, Position).

The service layer never prints anything. It hands back a MoveResult and lets whichever interface is in use (the console now, a GUI in Phase 2) decide how to show it.

Instances are immutable and are created through the static factory methods success and failure(String).
